card.fact_statement: Landgericht Aschaffenburg imposed involuntary commitment on the perpetrator on 30 October 2025.
card.source_span: On 30 October 2025, after a six-day trial, Landgericht Aschaffenburg imposed involuntary commitment to a psychiatric institution.

target_qa_variants.question: À quelle date le Landgericht Aschaffenburg a-t-il imposé l'internement d'office à l'auteur de l'attaque au couteau d'Aschaffenbourg de 2025 ?
target_qa_variants.source_span: On 30 October 2025, after a six-day trial, Landgericht Aschaffenburg imposed involuntary commitment to a psychiatric institution.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'involuntary commitment' to 'internement d'office', a standard French legal term for this concept. Kept 'Landgericht Aschaffenburg' as the proper name of the court.

backtranslation_en.question: On what date did the Landgericht Aschaffenburg impose compulsory internment on the perpetrator of the 2025 Aschaffenburg knife attack?
